subject.title: BL-buying-cart-04: la fecha de recogida solo bloquea domingos, no festivos

question: Should the holiday rule land with the linked PR’s national-holiday calculation for ES/PT/IT/FR, or should this issue require broader local/API-backed holiday coverage before merge?
rationale: Current code has a confirmed backend gap, but the requested holiday source and locality scope affect checkout behavior on a revenue path and should be accepted by the Supply/BL owner before closing.

options.title: Accept national-holiday scope
options.body: Review and land the linked PR after conflicts are resolved, treating local/regional holidays as a later follow-up if needed.

options.title: Require broader holiday source
options.body: Keep the issue open until the implementation covers local holidays or an approved external holiday API for the supported countries.

options.title: Narrow to Spain first
options.body: Ship a smaller Spain-only backend check aligned with the existing client list and track international coverage separately.

recommendation.title: Accept national-holiday scope
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR after conflicts are resolved, treating local/regional holidays as a later follow-up if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is the issue reporter/assignee and authored the candidate fix PR for the BL buying-cart divergence.
